regressions.before: Early cancel rejected but pg_stat_activity still had one active SQL
regressions.after: CancelRequest + original-query drain + channel barrier before rollback/release; no active late SQL
regressions.negative: lost acknowledgement bounded by statement remainder + 500ms cleanup grace; DATABASE_CANCELLATION_UNCONFIRMED, no automatic retry; COMMIT uncertainty preserved

regressions.before: Fastify 5.12.3 IncomingMessage normal body close aborted request.signal and cleared handler timer; real HTTP PUTs returned 503
regressions.after: owned monotonic deadline, normal body completion ignored; actual disconnect cancels; deadline response before held handler resumes

regressions.before: 4000 requests on one source/member hit 600/180 per-route limits; 3220 errors in old CI baseline
regressions.after: 100 bounded synthetic sources/members, unchanged limits; explicit 429/all errors/statuses; identical measurement code for both runtimes

regressions.before: Capacity SLO ignored client errors and CI used forbidden output directory
regressions.after: all request errors and per-route 500ms targets gate results; protected output root retained; failure does not prevent other cohort collection

regressions.before: worker success not asserted; test-looking remote DB accepted by name alone
regressions.after: processed/pending/dead counts asserted; explicit local-only benchmark DB URL

baseline.timingBoundary: server app.inject + isolated DB; no DNS/TLS/mobile/rendering

candidate.timingBoundary: server app.inject + isolated DB; no DNS/TLS/mobile/rendering

capacity.population: 100 real Linux loopback source addresses, no proxy-header spoofing

limitations: Audit-only events measure claim/finalize throughput, not publication SQL or external I/O.
Loopback PostgreSQL and an unconstrained workstation are not staging or production capacity evidence.
Process-kill recovery is covered by functional tests, not timed by this harness.
